$description: NumberInput V2 Component Contract. One public numeric-input identity adapts integer and decimal Qt spin editors.

stateLayers.pointerInteraction: hover and pressed overlays on the active button slot
stateLayers.availability: disabled, error and loading lock interaction

compositionRules: NumberInput is the public semantic component; SpinBox and DoubleSpinBox are Qt editor adapters, not competing public design identities.
Type selects the runtime editor and does not duplicate visual tokens.
Controls selects the visible stepper structure. SplitPlusMinus paints two complete side slots separated from the field; PlusMinus and UpDown paint an exact stacked control region.
The container border is continuous. Button slots own their surface and hit region; the divider is shared and is not a second outer border.
Hover and pressed overlays are clipped to the active increment/decrement sub-control and never spill into the field or the other button.
ReadOnly uses the disabled visual and locks interaction. Error and Loading also lock editing; Loading adds the shared dynamic Spinner.
Value range, step, precision, locale and grouping are runtime APIs, not design axes or Token combinations.
